# Weather Data Client

Run with `dotnet run`. Supply an API endpoint or mock response through configuration; do not commit API keys.

## Done when

- [ ] Use HttpClient with timeout/cancellation
- [ ] Deserialize JSON into typed models
- [ ] Validate input and required response fields
- [ ] Handle unsuccessful status codes and network failures
